projection_query:
select a.node_id agreement_node,c.node_id company_node,c.companyName,t.node_id tdoc_node,t.tdocNumber,ai.node_id agenda_node
from Agreement a join rel_REFERENCES rf on rf.src_id=a.node_id join Tdoc t on t.node_id=rf.dst_id
join rel_SUBMITTED_BY sb on sb.src_id=t.node_id join Company c on c.node_id=sb.dst_id
join rel_RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO rb on rb.src_id=a.node_id join AgendaItem ai on ai.node_id=rb.dst_id
where ai.agendaNumber like '7.1%' OR exists(select 1 from AgendaItem p where p.meetingNumber=ai.meetingNumber and lower(p.agendaDescription) like '%mimo%' and (p.agendaNumber=ai.agendaNumber or ai.agendaNumber like p.agendaNumber||'.%'))
order by a.node_id,c.node_id,t.node_id,ai.node_id
scope: Union of literal7.1 and lexicalMIMO parent scopes for diagnostic replay only; not complete NR MIMO technical annotation.
